description: This file defines a PHP class 'Language' within the Opencart\'Catalog\Controller\Event' namespace. The class extends a base controller and contains methods related to handling language variables and maintaining language state across different points in a request cycle, such as before and after controller execution.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Controller class that manages language variables, including saving and restoring language data during request processing.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Populates arguments with all language variables if they aren't already set.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Stores current language variables into a backup before controller executes.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Restores language variables from backup after controller executes.
